text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I noticed a flyer for a 
"Horse Girl Pro-Wrestling Trial Event" and 
decided to check it out—

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. That wraps up our warm-ups. 
Next, let's move on to our usual 
conditioning routine. *ahem*... Are you 
ready, you lot!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Osu! YES! We are at FULL POWER, 
Dober-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... I'm not really used to yelling out 
like that... Besides, why did I even join 
an event like this in the first place...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you looking for somewhere fun to 
go on your day off?! That is why El 
brought you to a fun place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I did say that, but... Even so, 
pro-wrestling horse girls are so huge 
after all... It's kinda intimidating.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! Wrestlers have 
extra-large bodies, but their hearts are 
extra-large too! There's no need to be 
scared!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's do it together! ONE! TWO! 
THREE!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: F... Five! Six! Seven!

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Mm, good fighting spirit! Listen up... 
Listen well! Squats are the most crucial 
exercise for a wrestler! Keep at it 
tirelessly, and—

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
You can pull off moves like this! Here we 
go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the horse girl wrestler leaped 
onto the makeshift ring and showcased a 
spectacular aerial maneuver!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! A-Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A true finishing hold! A match-deciding 
special move! How about that? Aren't 
wrestlers amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... it's actually pretty interesting.

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Now then! For our grand finale today! The 
ring entrance trial! Anyone here want to 
experience entering like a real wrestler!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh, an entrance... like a real wrestler, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, YES! In that case, without a 
doubt! El and company will go first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, "and company" means me too...?!

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Now, step into this ring surrounded by 
green! Entering next is the invincible 
lucha libre champion, EEEEEEL THE 
GREEEEEEAT!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: FOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Masked Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Followed by the ultimate weapon born from 
a prestigious wrestling dynasty! The 
entrance of Strong Dober... huh, wait?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Dober-senpai?! Let's 
get up into the ring together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't do that! Climbing into the ring 
with all eyes on me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I'm not strong-hearted like 
you, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! El isn't that strong either, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But this mask always gives El courage!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So... I will share some of that courage 
with you, Dober-senpai!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Thank you all for waiting! The 
undisputed strongest tag team! The Condor 
& Dobers have arrived!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The phantom bird of the ring, El the 
Great! I'll enchant you with my brilliant 
aerial favorite move!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I've got all their attention! 
Once you're in the ring, you've got this! 
All you have to do is introduce yourself 
with pride!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A-And... I-I... I am...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: S-S... STRONG DOBER—!

text_block_list.name: Event Participants
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! El! Dober! El! Dober~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, everyone was staring at me 
like crazy, but once I did it, it was 
pretty fun. It was all thanks to El taking 
the lead.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... That is precisely thanks to the 
mask! As long as I have this mask, El will 
always be the world's greatest 
entertainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I merely shared a tiny bit of my 
overflowing courage! The rest was all 
Dober-senpai's own power, yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Then for me, I guess you were the 
mask that gave me that push, El.
